advisories.reason: Only @tailwindcss/typography > postcss-selector-parser 6.0.10 resolves this finding. The plugin parses repository typography selectors during landing CSS generation, not request-provided selectors. The advisory requires 7.1.6, which crosses the current 6.x consumer contract; defer that migration and recheck before accepting untrusted stylesheet builds.
advisories.fixGate: Tailwind typography compatibility review for selector-parser >=7.1.6

advisories.reason: Resolved paths are Sass 1.77.4 > chokidar 3.6.0 > braces 3.0.3, reached through framework and Vite peers. Chokidar expands watched filesystem glob patterns during Sass compilation; first-party runtime code does not accept request-controlled watch patterns or invoke Sass compilation. The library can remain in image traces: build reachability is a source-use classification, not proof of artifact absence. No fixed version is published; restrict build inputs to reviewed repository content and recheck before dynamic compilation.
advisories.fixGate: Published patched braces compatible with chokidar

SMTP options and provider transport behavior are preserved.
